user.title: Connect to RTK-Base
user.description: Enter the Raspberry Pi address serving the RTK-Base dashboard. The default HTTP port is 80.

data_description.host: For example, http://rtk-base.local or http://192.168.1.25. Port 80 is the default; include a port only if you configured nginx to use a different one.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address with an optional port.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Pi. Check its address, port, and network connection.
error.invalid_data: The Pi returned invalid system stats. Confirm RTK-Base is installed and up to date.

abort.already_configured: This RTK-Base device is already configured.
